data.title: The Sanctuary
data.about:
Experience Ellington’s The Sanctuary. The magnificent homes here are located within a private gated community that provides a privileged lifestyle. These four- to six-bedroom houses come in four distinct designs, each with its own amenities and options. 

Each modern villa has a private pool, rooftop patio, and courtyard and is only a short walk from a stunning central lagoon. The Sanctuary is Ellington’s first master-planned community. A unique collection of villas with easy access to all Dubai has to offer, as well as breathtaking views of the famous Dubai skyline and the Burj Khalifa.

location_tile.title: Seemless & Easy Access
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
This spectacular megadevelopment, located in Mohammed Bin Rashid City’s District 11, provides eight million square feet of resort-style residences, premium services, and green open spaces in the heart of a bustling city. An aspirant community with good schools, recreational opportunities, and a large parklands.

  • Academic City 15 Mins
  • Burj Khalifa 25 Mins
  • Dubai Creek Harbour and Golf Club 20 Mins
  • Palm Jumeirah 20 Mins
  • FC 25 Mins
